entrypoints: cmd/kata/mcp.go (kata mcp serve, stdio or Streamable HTTP)
web/ and packages/kata-ui (browser UI served by the daemon)

providers.note: Provider-neutral issue_sync tables and /issue-sync/{provider} routes. GitHub is the only adapter. One-way import. Config must not hold raw tokens.
Opt-in. Any local or hosted endpoint that speaks that wire format. Kata does not bundle a model.
SQLite under KATA_HOME by default. Postgres via KATA_DSN. Clients do not open either database.
Process protocol and conformance kit only. No daemon config, bindings, or sync.
Mutual trust replicas. Not an LLM provider and not multi-tenant auth.

top_risks: Editing SQLite or Postgres store code without the other backend.
Branching from origin/dev or replaying fix/beads-import-aegis-20260810 over the landed importer.
Inferring issue closure from git, or closing without a substantive message and typed evidence.
Sending a daemon token, catalog admin token, or browser credential to the wrong origin.
Weakening Host, Origin, or split browser-session checks so another client class works.
Adding connector or other unknown keys to daemon config.toml.
Changing production schema or migrations without explicit consent.
Putting hooks or secrets in committed .kata.toml.
Treating docs-assets or stale May-July 2026 branches as merge candidates.
Assuming MCP typed tools are loaded before their section loader runs.
